notes: Video recipes keep timing, references, camera motion, and edit intent separate.
P2a compiles local edit intent only; it does not call a real edit provider.

seedance2.promptLanguage: provider-facing English by default; preserve required on-screen text or subtitles in the original language
referencePolicies: Every referenced asset must have a role: first frame, last frame, character, scene, camera motion, action, effect, rhythm, BGM, sound effect, or voice tone.
Use first-frame and last-frame references for precise start/end control instead of packing too many actions into one prompt.
Use video references for camera motion, action choreography, effects, transitions, and rhythm; do not describe them as generic style references.
Use audio references for BGM, tempo, sound effects, or voice/tone; preserve native audio output by default when the exact model capability profile says nativeAudio=true.

avoid: do not pack multiple scene changes into 4-5 seconds
do not leave asset references without a role

timed_storyboard.label: Timed storyboard video
enhancements: 单段只推进一个主要动作

character_continuity.label: Character continuity clip
avoid: 每段重新描述导致身份漂移

local_edit.label: Local video/image edit intent
avoid: 把局部编辑写成全量重生成
